The '''North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show''' was an event that took place on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /><ref name="Email" />

==History==
[[File:RA7ProtocolDroid-NEGTD.png|thumb|right|150px|The RA-7 protocol droid made its first public appearance at the North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show on Zug.]]
At some point around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /><ref name="Email" /> [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] unveiled its first [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droids]] during the event, thus announcing its entry into the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] market.<ref name="TNEGtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show was first mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2006]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TNEGtD" />

In his endnotes for ''The New Essential Guide to Droids'', Wallace explained that the North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show on Zug mirrored the [[Wikipedia:North American International Auto Show|North American International Auto Show]] in [[Wikipedia:Detroit|Detroit]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|53|Endnotes for The New Essential Guide to Droids: PART 2 of 3}}</ref>
